projects.name: BigFishDockpro
projects.description: BigFish Dock (BigFishDockpro) is a desktop organization and beautification tool for Windows 10 / 11 x64. Frequently used apps can be dragged into the Dock, arranged in groups, and launched or managed in bulk. Files, folders, and shortcuts can be automatically sorted into desktop cards. Cards can be placed independently, merged into tabbed pages, and searched. When collapsed, the resource capsule shows key readings and alerts; when expanded, it shows hardware status, network traffic, weather, AI usage, and schedule. The desktop can also add sticky notes, clocks, a lunar calendar, a daily image, and a music spectrum on demand. The Dock and desktop widgets support multiple materials, including liquid glass, and colors, transparency, and layout can be freely adjusted. The Windows 11 Start menu, native search, and notification panel can also adopt the Dock's appearance. Idle hidden pages automatically release resources and load on demand when reopened.
projects.originalDescription: 大肥鱼Dock（BigFishDockpro） 是一款面向 Windows 10 / 11 x64 的桌面整理与美化工具。常用应用可以拖入 Dock，按组摆放、快速启动和批量管理。文件、文件夹和快捷方式可自动分类到桌面卡片，卡片支持独立摆放、合并切页和搜索。资源胶囊收起时显示关键读数和提醒，展开后可查看硬件状态、网络流量、天气、AI 用量和日程。桌面还可按需添加便签、时钟、农历日历、每日图片和音乐频谱。Dock 与桌面组件支持液态玻璃等多种材质，配色、透明度与布局可自由调整。Windows 11 的开始菜单、原生搜索和通知面板也可沿用 Dock 的外观。闲置的隐藏页面会自动释放资源，再次打开时按需加载。
